answer: Instead of hunting sybils, blunt them: every grade, vote or price signal is settled by the median of a small jury drawn at random from all keys, never by a sum. A farm holding 5% of keys almost never seats a majority on a jury of eleven, so its fakes land on the outer ledge of the distribution and get trimmed, while the median rests on a flat mesa of honest opinion. Pushing a friend to the summit of the rankings would mean owning over half the network.
